who: Real stack · local stand-ins for Shopify, Amazon SP-API and the warehouse
title: Sell the same stock on Shopify and Amazon without overselling
sub: One stock ledger for both channels and the warehouse: bundles, safety buffers, sell-outs pushed in about a second, oversells caught.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · Shopify Admin API · Amazon SP-API · signed webhooks · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.

caps.text: Each channel shows what's available, minus its own safety buffer. Bundles follow their scarcest part
A Shopify customer buys the last 3 kettles…
…and Amazon shows 0 about a second later. The next Amazon buyer is refused
The worst case: Shopify's webhook is late while Amazon sells the same grinders
Caught: the order can't be filled, and nothing is half-reserved. The exception says exactly what's short
The warehouse receives 10 grinders. One click, and the order is reserved
Every change is a movement in the ledger, with its reference and the stock after it
Reconciliation: a stock count differs. It's only booked when it shows twice, so shipments in flight don't count
And a quantity someone typed into Shopify by hand is found and put right
Back to one truth on every channel
